title: Slicer
description: Mod for blades with different blocks and repairs
body:
This Minecraft mod adds new combat weapons and unique decorative blocks to enhance your gameplay experience. Perfect for both survival adventures and creative building projects.

**Weapons:**

Blade - A standard combat weapon for enhanced melee fighting

HidePurityBlade - A specialized blade with unique properties

DeathBlade - A blade for a true warrior and destroyer

**Decorative Blocks:**

EmeraldDiamondBlock - A luxurious block combining emerald and diamond aesthetics

BambuBlackBlock - A dark bamboo-themed block for modern builds

Deepseabedshale - An ocean-floor inspired block for underwater themes

VeryDryGravel - A weathered gravel variant for desert or wasteland builds

GoodcleanBrick - A pristine brick block for clean, refined constructions

**Features:**

Two unique blade types for expanded combat options

Four distinctive decorative blocks with varied textures and themes

Seamless integration with vanilla Minecraft gameplay

Compatible with survival mode progression

Adds both functional and aesthetic content to your world
